51401743.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to purified recombinant human NEK7 by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface-Plasmon: The SPR assay was performed on a BLAcore T200 biosensor system (GE Healthcare Life Sciences, Piscataway, NJ, USA) at 25 °C using a CM5 chip. The binding of NEK7 at different concentrations of BBR was performed in 1 × PBS-P+ (GE Healthcare Life Sciences) at a flow rate of 20 μL/min for 120 s. After each binding reaction, a further dissociation time of 60 s was applied after each injection to allow the signal to return to the baseline.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption - part k: SPR sensorgrams obtained on an NEK7-coated chip at different concentrations of BBR.
original_paragraph.Figure 2k: The x-axis is labeled 'Time (sec)' with a range from 0 to 200. The y-axis is labeled 'Response'. Four curves are shown, each corresponding to a different concentration of BBR: 3.12 μM (blue), 6.25 μM (red), 12.5 μM (green), and 25 μM (purple). The association phase occurs from 0 to 150 seconds, and the dissociation phase from 150 to 200 seconds.
